docs.title: Welcome to RizomUV Bridge
docs.text: RizomUV Bridge connects Autodesk 3ds Max with RizomUV by RizomLabs, enabling a seamless and efficient workflow for UVW channel exchange.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Seamless Transfer: Send objects from 3ds Max to RizomUV with a single click.
  • Automatic Sync: Updates UVs automatically when you save in RizomUV.
  • Automation Tools: Run common RizomUV operations (Pack, Unfold, Optimize) directly from 3ds Max.
  • Scripting Support: Run custom Lua scripts on your geometry within RizomUV.
  • Format Choice: Support for both FBX and USD (Universal Scene Description) formats.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Select your object in 3ds Max.
  2. Click "Send" to open it in RizomUV.
  3. Unwrap your model.
  4. Click "Save" in RizomUV to update the object in 3ds Max.

Get Started with Installation

docs.title: System Requirements
docs.text:
• Autodesk 3ds Max: Versions 2025/26/xx.
  • RizomUV: Version 2025.xx
  • OS: Windows 11

docs.title: Installation Steps
docs.text: There are two primary ways to install the RizomUV Bridge:

docs.title: Method 1: Drag and Drop (Recommended)
docs.text:
1. Locate the .mzp file in the downloaded package (e.g., RizomUVBridge.mzp).
    • Note: If you have the raw files, you might need to run the install.ms script manually or create an MZP package.
  2. Drag and drop the file directly into an active 3ds Max viewport.
  3. An installation dialog may appear confirming the successful installation.

docs.title: Method 2: Run Script
docs.text:
1. Open 3ds Max.
  2. Go to Scripting > Run Script... in the main menu.
  3. Navigate to the RizomUV Bridge .mzp file and select it.

docs.title: Post-Installation
docs.text:
Once installed:

  1. Navigate to Customize > Customize User Interface.
  2. Go to the Toolbars tab.
  3. Find the category "Titus_Scripts".
  4. Drag the RizomUV command to a toolbar of your choice.
  5. You should see the RizomUV icon ready to use.

Permissions

You may need Administrator rights to install scripts into certain 3ds Max directories. If installation fails, try running 3ds Max as Administrator.

docs.title: User Guide
docs.text: This guide explains the interface and workflows of the RizomUV Bridge.

docs.title: Interface Overview
docs.text:
The RizomUV Bridge window is divided into several logical sections:

  1. Actions: The main controls for transferring data (Send, Get, Sync).
  2. RizomUV Tools: Access to common RizomUV algorithms (Cut, Pack, etc.).
  3. Scripts: Execute custom Lua scripts.
  4. Connection: Manage the link to RizomUV application (Start/Close).
  5. Preferences: Collapsible section for configuration.

docs.title: Connection State
docs.text: When RizomUV is not running, the interface simplifies to show only the Start button:

docs.title: Sending Objects
docs.text:
1. Selection: Select one or more Editable Poly objects in 3ds Max.
    • Tip: The bridge works best with Editable Poly objects.
  2. Click "Send": This exports the geometry to a temporary file and commands RizomUV to load it.
  3. RizomUV Opens: The application will launch (if not running) and load your mesh.

docs.title: Getting Results
docs.text: Usually, the bridge automates the return process. However, you can manually trigger it: 1. Save in RizomUV: Press Ctrl+S in RizomUV to save the temp file. 2. Click "Get": Checks for the output file from RizomUV and imports the updated UVs onto your original mesh.

docs.title: RizomUV Tools
docs.text:
The bridge exposes direct buttons for common RizomUV commands so you don't always have to switch windows:

  • Weld All / Weld Selected: Welds UV vertices.
  • Cut: Performs a cut operation based on current selection/seams.
  • Unfold: Runs the Unfold algorithm.
  • Optimize: Optimizes the UV distortion.
  • Pack: Packs the UV islands into the UV tile.

docs.title: Running Scripts
docs.text:
You can execute custom Lua scripts on your mesh within RizomUV:

  1. Select Script: Choose a script from the dropdown menu.
  2. Folder: Click ... to change the folder where your scripts are stored.
  3. Run Script: Executes the selected script immediately in RizomUV.

docs.title: Preferences
docs.text: This section is collapsible to save space. Click "Preferences" to expand.

docs.title: File Format
docs.text: You can choose the intermediate format used for data exchange: * FBX (Default): Robust and widely supported. * USD: Uses Universal Scene Description for exchange.

docs.title: Export Cleanup Options
docs.text:
Configure how meshes are processed before sending to RizomUV:

  • Collapse Dead Structs: Removes unused data structures.
  • Delete Iso Verts: Deletes isolated vertices.
  • Delete Iso Map Verts: Deletes isolated map vertices.
  • Rebuild Poly: Rebuilds the Editable Poly object to ensure data integrity.

docs.title: Other
docs.text:
• Mesh Inspector: Launches the Mesh Inspector tool to verify geometry.
  • Help: Opens the online documentation.

docs.title: Connection Issues
docs.text:
If the bridge cannot find rizomuv.exe:

  1. Ensure RizomUV is installed.
  2. The bridge will prompt you to locate the .exe file manually if auto-detection fails.
